name: Sony BRAVIA TL2
summary: Turn off Prime Video, Disney+, retail demo apps and partner auto-installs on the Sony BRAVIA TL2 with TidyTV, a free phone app with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The Sony BRAVIA TL2 is built by TP Vision, the company behind some Philips sets, so it carries a similar TV layer. The list covers five apps that most owners skip, such as Prime Video and Disney+. It also turns off retail demo mode, partner auto-installs and a few Google leftovers.

The list was applied in two batches, with a screenshot and a Live TV and Chromecast check after each, then a restart. Home, Inputs, Live TV, Cast and voice all still worked, and everything stayed off after the restart. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, with a backup first. Restore everything switches them back on in one tap.
keep: Live TV, the tuner and HDMI inputs, which MediaTek services run.
The TV's own system layer from TP Vision, which runs the remote and sources.
Google Assistant, text-to-speech and the phone remote, so voice and phone control stay on.
notes: ARD, ZDF and Google Play Movies were already off from the factory, and the list leaves them as they are.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony BRAVIA TL2?
faq.a: Yes. Google Assistant and the text-to-speech service are kept on this set, so the mic button keeps working.
Yes. The Chromecast app is kept, so casting from a phone keeps working.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
